A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of a small forest glade, with many white flowers covering the grass below the dense trees, and with a single bigger tree in the middle, with a small hollow near the ground level. The sun lights up some trees and flowers, many tree branches are green, but some are still covered with the dried yellow leaves from the past year.
